2.  A regular meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Hepburn at 6: 30 p. m.
3.  Council Members  present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tem Muir Davis
  Council Member Robin Carder
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Rick Crosby

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel  present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  Assistant to the City Manager JR Ranells
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Gaeta Estrella
  Community Services Director Eric Scherer
  Contract Planner Vanessa Norwood
  City Engineer Cody Howing

4.  Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Hepburn.

5.  Announcements of Upcoming  Sherry Best, La Verne Historical Society President announced that they will be
  Community Events  holding their first membership and Community meeting on October 11, 2021
  and on October 23, 2021 will be the La Verne Historical Society Annual Old
  Timers Potluck picnic at Evelyn Hollinger' s Memorial Redwood Grove at Las
  Flores Park.

  the site  and  subdivision  of this parcel  into  nine  lots for the future  development

  of seven single- family dwelling units and finro open space lots located at 500

  Planning Commission recommended that the City Council conditionally
  approve the Baseline Single- Family Residential and Annexation Project, 500
  Baseline Road.

  Mayor Hepburn called for public comment on this matter.

  There  were  two public  comments  at  the meeting. ( To hear what was said

  during public comment, please visit the City' s website to view the archived
  Council meeting.)

  After discussion by the City Council of a median on Baseline Road, traffic
  safety concerns, and a request of an adjacent County resident to be added to
  the current annexation application, the City Council directed staff to meet with
  the County resident regarding the annexation process, if they choose to annex
  to the City and that later they would look at the other issues.

8.  At 7: 16 p. m., the City Council recessed and reconvened at 7: 18 p. m.

9.  Public Comment  This was the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on
  items not listed in any other place on the agenda.

  Mayor Hepburn called for public comment.

  Seven ( 7)  public comments received at the  meeting including one ( 1)
  telephonically. (  To hear what was said during public comment, please visit the
  City' s website to view the archived Council meeting.)

10.  Council Comments  Council Member Carder reported that that the Car Show was wonderful and
  well attended.  She reported on the Gold Line Construction and that funding
  was still needed to extend the Gold Line to Montclair.

  Council Member  Crosby reported that the Car Show was great. He spoke
  about the K- 9 supporters at the Car Show and their quest to get another K- 9
  dog and asking for community help. He congratulated Bonita High School
  Football Team for winning the Smudge Pot Football Game against San Dimas

  Council Member Lau reported that the Car Show was great and that it was a
  nice day for the event. She thanked all the coaches and families for their

  contribution  in making La Verne teams  a success.  She urged everyone to stay
  safe and  be kind to each other.
   City Council Minutes, Monday, September 20, 2021, Page 6,

  Mayor Pro Davis stated  the  Car Show was fabulous. He reported on the
  Pomona Valley Transportation Authority Meeting and he hoped that La Verne
  seniors were using the transportation opportunities offered by Get About and
  Ready Now. He spoke about the Gold Line Construction.  He congratulated
  Bonita High  School  Football  Team  for winning the Smudge Pot. He also
  commended the La Verne Little League Softball Team and said they were
  great  role  models.

  Mayor Hepburn stated that the Car Show was amazing and that the La Verne
  Little League Softball Team is a wonderful team. He congratulated Bonita
  High School Football Team for winning the Smudge Pot. He reported on the
  upcoming Taste of La Verne event in October. He thanked and spoke of the
  La Verne Firefighters who were deployed and who have returned from
  assisting other agencies in combatting fires. He urged residents to pay close
  attention to SB 9& 10, accessory dwellings that could eliminate single- family

  zoning.
